start: A gym member with a saved workout, on Profile's feed

user_sees: Its page: the name as a heading, the day and start time (' · Easy week' on an easy week), photos, stats, note, muscle split, every exercise with sets and records
Top buttons 'Share' and 'More'
must_not: Sets in the wrong unit
Another workout's sets

user_sees: That exercise's page
must_not: Two exercise pages from a fast double tap

user_sees: Sheet 'Share as a picture' with the workout picture and 'Share picture'
must_not: Body weight or a figure that divides back to it on the picture

user_sees: The phone's share menu with the PNG
must_not: Two share menus

start: A gym member on a saved workout's page

user_sees: The live workout with the same exercises and sets ready to log
must_not: An open in-progress workout overwritten without asking

steps.action: With a workout already open, tap 'Repeat workout'
user_sees: 'A workout is already open' with Resume or 'Discard and start new'
must_not: The open workout dropped silently

start: A gym member on a saved workout's page

user_sees: 'Where should the routine go?' with the folders
must_not: A routine saved with no folder choice

user_sees: 'Saved as a routine' with 'Open routine'
must_not: Two routines from a double tap

user_sees: 'Edit routine' of the new routine
must_not: The wrong routine opening

start: A gym member on a saved workout's page

user_sees: The workout editor with every set
must_not: A workout that cannot be shown faithfully opened for edit (it says 'Can't edit this one' instead)

user_sees: The workout's page again with the new weight
must_not: The old weight still shown
A second copy of the workout

steps.action: Tap 'More', 'Rename workout', type a new name, 'Save name'
user_sees: The new name as the heading
must_not: The name lost without 'Could not rename'

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo', pick a gallery photo
user_sees: The photo under the name; 'Up to 4. Private: they stay on this phone.'
must_not: A fifth photo accepted (it says '4 of 4 photos. Remove one to add another.')

start: A gym member with a workout link that fails or is gone

steps.action: Open a workout that was deleted
user_sees: 'Workout not found' - 'This workout may have been deleted.'
must_not: A crash
'Workout not found' for a read that only failed

steps.action: Open a workout whose read fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't load this workout' with try again
must_not: An endless grey block

user_sees: 'Could not delete this workout. It is still here. Please try again.'
must_not: The page closing as if deleted

steps.action: Edit an edited workout to zero sets and save
user_sees: 'A workout needs at least one set. To get rid of it entirely, discard these changes and delete the workout instead.'
must_not: An empty workout saved

start: A gym member on a saved workout's page

user_sees: 'Delete this workout?' - 'This removes the workout and its sets.' with 'Delete'
must_not: Deleting without asking

user_sees: Back on the page before (or Profile); the workout gone from the feed, its records gone from Records
must_not: The workout still in the feed
A record left from the deleted workout

steps.action: Edit another workout, then discard the changes
user_sees: Back on that workout's page, unchanged
must_not: Half of the changes saved

user_sees: The photo gone; 'Add photo' shows one more left
must_not: The photo back after reopening

start: A gym member with photos on a workout and sharing with trainers on

user_sees: 'Private: they stay on this phone.'
must_not: The photo sent to the gym or a trainer

user_sees: Only workout sets and figures in the text
must_not: Body weight, measurements or photos in the text
